api_check: coax/web/api/test_npc.py posts every ask and refused body with a player key and expects its status; an answered ask's body is the first answer's bytes
transport: POST /api/playtest/npc/ask, X-Verse-Player required; one compact JSON object, keys in field-number order (npc, world or realm, visit, scene, history, question). The answer: 200 {"text": ..., "model": ...} as Postgres jsonb text.
about: Each ask's values are written by wire.coax to json byte for byte, and json reads back to the values. Taken from what the four pages wrote before E4 (#13247): Everglade's people.coax, Fairy Forest's talk.coax, the Haunted House's realm.coax and made realms' myrealm.coax. A text's control byte is sent as a space, so values hold none. Every refused body is refused by the reader (and, with values, by the writer) and by the API with its status.
